name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 8 visits over 13 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 23 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 25 hours starting 2025-07-19, at wavelengths from 0.83 to 2.06 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
